title: Production Lead Times by Build Class — Factory Production Orders
content:
The plant schedules Factory Production Orders on the lead times below. All figures are business days: Monday through Friday, excluding U.S. federal holidays.

| Build class | Standard lead time | Large-order threshold (units) | Large-order extension | Order entry after the contract's order release |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Custom Size Build | 20 | 20 | 5 | within 2 |
| Custom Color Build | 30 | 20 | 5 | within 2 |
| Specialty Glass Build | 30 | 15 | 5 | within 2 |
| Specialty Shape Build | 40 | 8 | 10 | within 2 |
| Impact-Rated Build | 50 | 10 | 10 | within 2 |
| Architectural Wood Build | 60 | 15 | 10 | within 2 |

## What each column means

- **Standard lead time** — the production lead time from order entry to the committed ship date.
- **Large-order threshold** — the unit count *above* which the large-order extension is added to the lead time. An order carrying exactly the threshold number of units is not above it.
- **Large-order extension** — the business days added to the lead time for an order above the threshold.
- **Order entry** — the business days after the contract's order release within which the factory enters the order.

## Threshold on both sides (hypothetical unit counts)

| Class | Units on the order | Above the threshold? | Lead time that applies |
|---|---|---|---|
| Custom Size Build | 20 | no (20 is not above 20) | 20 |
| Custom Size Build | 21 | yes | 20 and 5 more, 25 in total |
| Specialty Shape Build | 8 | no | 40 |
| Specialty Shape Build | 9 | yes | 40 and 10 more, 50 in total |
| Impact-Rated Build | 11 | yes | 50 and 10 more, 60 in total |
